summary: Verified fix for Year Comparison party dropdown 1000-cap bug. Backend endpoint /api/analytics/year-comparison/parties now returns full lists (3220 customers, 1186 suppliers) with late-alphabet names (YCTEST CUSTOMER 1199, ZIL SILVER..., YCTEST SUPPLIER 1099, ZEENAT SILVER CHAMMACH) present. Party-detail endpoint returns 200. Monthly-profit regression endpoint still returns unique items. Frontend /year-comparison drill-down shows correct count labels (3220 customers, 1186 suppliers), filtered datalist (capped at 100 DOM options) surfaces names beyond the old 1000 alphabetical cutoff (e.g. YCTEST CUSTOMER 1150), and detail chart section renders for both customer and supplier selections.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing seeded YCTEST customer/supplier docs)
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_41: bug fix validated end-to-end. Backend cap removal + frontend filtered datalist working. Note frontend datalist DOM caps at 100 filtered matches by design — verified via typing 'YCTEST CUSTOMER 11' which surfaced YCTEST CUSTOMER 1100..1150+ (proving late-alphabet reachability). Ask main agent to clean up 1200 YCTEST customer / 1100 YCTEST supplier seeded docs (year=2018 party_customer/party_supplier monthly_summaries) once bug closed.
rca_of_the_issue: Original endpoint applied [:1000] slice on alphabetically sorted party names, silently truncating any party beyond the 1000th name. Fix: cap removed on backend; frontend datalist filters in-memory list by substring (case-insensitive) with 100-option DOM cap for perf while keeping the full list for exact-match selection.
